title: GA Approval Gate
objective: Memutuskan release, delay, subset reduction, atau rollback berdasarkan beta evidence.

beta_results.summary: 117.1 beta entry gate records canonical_entry_readiness BLOCKED_NO_CERTIFIED_CONNECTOR_CURRENTLY_RECORDED with live_beta_executed false; 117.4 certification snapshot lock froze 32 providers with zero CERTIFIED (32 UNVERIFIED) and cohort_verdict COHORT_CONSENT_VERIFICATION_FAILED; 117.37 beta feedback evidence log is the only recorded beta-facing evidence and it is a local measurement, not a live beta result. No live beta was executed, so there are no beta_results to approve.

connector_registry.summary: 117.41 final connector registry reconciliation records provider_count 32, status_counts CERTIFIED 0 / UNVERIFIED 32, visibility_counts EXPOSED 0 / WITHHELD 32, exposed_provider_ids empty. The registry exposes no certified connector, so a release cannot be justified from it.

blocker_status.summary: 117.39 GA blocker resolution measured only 2 of 9 canonical domains (crash, security) and left 7 unresolved (accessibility, auth, billing, data, privacy, quota, sync). 117.43 GA artifact & reproducibility recorded pass=false with failures on checksums/artifact_checksum_agreement. The release_blocker_status for GA remains open, so the gate records release_blocked true.

quality_gates.summary: 117.40 Full Regression & Gate Rerun measured 10/10 canonical suites (574 test cases, 0 failures) across four deterministic shards with analyzer and Windows debug build exit 0; the 117.35 performance and 117.36 resilience manifests back the performance and recovery shards. The local gate suite is green, which is necessary but not sufficient for GA.

known_limits.summary: 117.42 documentation & known limitations reconciled all 8 required outputs against 32 providers. Developer connectors now declare the explicit developer_repository permission scope; they remain UNVERIFIED and WITHHELD until connector certification.

signed_artifacts.summary: 117.43 GA artifact & reproducibility measured 8 required outputs with 6 signed artifacts; the manifest verdict is GA_ARTIFACT_REPRODUCIBILITY_INCOMPLETE (pass=false, measured 2026-10-02, not re-measured since). The sole failing group is checksums (artifact_checksum_agreement). Commit 02279bc (2026-10-05) regenerated the committed checksum index from a freshly rebuilt and re-signed rc.1 tree — the repair is attested on the release machine but is not independently re-verifiable in a clean checkout, where all 493 index paths resolve under gitignored build/. connector_manifest, icon_manifest, and provenance are absent from the 113.38 packaging manifest as a recorded boundary (failures name only checksums, not the trio). Signed artifact agreement therefore remains unmeasured, not disproven.

rollout_plan.summary: 117.44 staged GA rollout plan is determined, never enabled: 3 stages (5%/25%/100%) over the certified subset with health criteria, stop conditions, kill switches, rollback, and support recorded. enabled_subset is empty because no verified participant cohort exists, so there is no cohort to release to.

rollback_readiness.summary: 117.8 provider rollback drill defines 6 required controls (kill_switch, token_revoke, queue_stop, cache_handling, artifact_rollback, communication) with full coverage but every control executed=false and drilled_against_live_provider=false; 117.6 support incident readiness defines the P0-P3 severity matrix and recovery guides. Rollback readiness is documentary, not drilled end-to-end.

approval.note: The gate records a delay because sprint 117's committed evidence cannot support a release: no certified connector (117.41: 0 CERTIFIED of 32), beta entry blocked (117.1: BLOCKED_NO_CERTIFIED_CONNECTOR_CURRENTLY_RECORDED), no live beta executed, artifact reproducibility incomplete (117.43: pass=false), and rollback drill not executed. A release outcome would additionally require Choirudin's explicit approval, a clear release blocker, and confirmed rollback readiness, none of which hold. The final GA go/no-go remains Choirudin's explicit decision.

rollback_readiness.note: Readiness is documentary. The rollback drill is defined and each control has an expected outcome, but no control has been executed and no rollback has been drilled against a live provider; the rollout plan's kill switches are recorded, not drilled.

limits: This is a decision record, not an approval machine: writing the manifest never authorizes a release. A release outcome additionally requires explicit approval, no active release blocker, and confirmed rollback readiness.
The recorded outcome is delay because the committed evidence cannot support a release; it is a governance record awaiting Choirudin's explicit final GA go/no-go decision.
No connector is enabled, no stage is advanced, no kill switch is drilled, and no rollback is executed; those remain external gates.
Local-only evidence: no hosted CI, live telemetry, public-trust signing, or end-to-end published-artifact rollback is claimed.
